title: The most mind-blowing concept in music (Harmonic Series)
summary: Andrew Huang explains the harmonic series, which he calls the foundation of almost all music. He builds the idea up step by step, with demonstrations of overtones and how harmonies derive from them.
why: HN recommends it as a clear, short but in-depth explanation of harmonics and overtones, useful even for musicians.

quote.text: Music producer Andrew Huang does a fantastic job demonstrating the harmonic series concepts
